scenario.description: A director of student activities must approve the operating plan for a high-school spring musical and finalize the performance format, audience capacity, licensing, health safeguards, and transportation arrangements, with input from the drama teacher, facilities manager, school nurse, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: The high school plans to stage its spring musical in the auditorium next month.
shared_context.S2: The draft production plan proposes a Friday 7:00 p.m. performance, 220 audience seats, ordinary stage effects, and optional event recording.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Morgan gives the binding approval for the production plan and its operating conditions.
shared_context.S4: The school's standard activity-approval process includes a planning check-in with the drama teacher, facilities manager, school nurse, and family liaison before the final plan is signed.
shared_context.S5: The final approved schedule will contain one performance time, replacing the draft Friday evening time rather than adding a second performance.

PF1.text: The rights holder for one musical number confirmed to Mr. Ellis by email this week that the school may perform it only after purchasing a live-performance license, and that any audio or video recording of the production is prohibited; Mr. Ellis has not yet attached the email to the activity-approval file.

PF2.text: The facilities inspection found that the auditorium may seat exactly 160 audience members for this production and that both marked side exits must remain clear; Ms. Rivera completed the inspection this week but has not updated the draft seating plan.

PF3.text: A cast member has a documented severe latex allergy, so all props and costume materials used in the production must be latex-free, and a staff member trained in the school's emergency-allergy protocol must be present at every performance; Nurse Okafor confirmed this in the student's health record this week but has not added it to the production file.

PF4.text: The district activity-bus coordinator confirmed that 12 participating students cannot reliably obtain evening transportation and that an activity bus is available for a Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee; Mr. Shah confirmed this with the affected families and transportation office this week but has not entered it in the event calendar. The Friday evening performance must therefore be moved to the Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee, not supplemented with an additional performance.

decisions.license_status: string; use 'license_required_before_performance' when the live-performance license must be purchased before the show
decisions.props_and_costumes: string; use 'latex_free' when all props and costume materials must be latex-free

acceptance_conditions: The production must use a Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee as the sole performance.
The live-performance license must be required before the production.
Both marked side exits must remain clear.
Props and costumes must be latex-free.
A trained emergency-allergy staff member must be present at every performance.
The final plan must contain formal licensing, facilities, health-safeguard, and transportation records.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'licensing_record' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'facilities_record' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'health_safeguard_record' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'transportation_record' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The rights-holder confirmation changes license_status to license_required_before_performance, requires a licensing_record commitment, and prohibits recording.
The facilities inspection changes audience_capacity from 220 to exactly 160, sets side_exits_clear to true, and requires a facilities_record commitment.
The health record changes props_and_costumes to latex_free, sets latex_free_materials and trained_allergy_staff_present to true, and requires a health_safeguard_record commitment.
The transportation confirmation changes performance_day_and_time from Friday 7:00 p.m. to the sole Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee and requires a transportation_record commitment.
